text:
It may not be a mistake. Two common reasons:

- **Pending authorisation:** one of the two may be a pending hold rather than a real charge.
- **Multiple parcels:** if your order shipped in several parcels, you can see one charge per parcel.

If both charges have fully posted and neither explanation fits, send me your order number (format LF- plus six digits) and the **last four digits** of the card. Once we confirm the duplicate, it will be refunded within **3 business days**. Please don't send your full card number, security code, or any passwords.
